# SheetDiff
Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.
SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local
HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave co
mments for a follow-up with your agent.
Use it after an agent or a person has saved a revised table: keep the original, compare the two file
s by an order ID or another unique key, and send specific corrections back. Row and column reorderin
g does not drown out actual data changes. It works through a CLI with any editor, or as an independe
nt DeepSeek Harness plugin. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require
Harness plugin. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.
## Try a review in two minutes — no installation
Download the interactive sample, extract it, and open `index.html` in your browser. No Node.js, Harn
ess, account or API key is needed to review the sample.
The example is a **synthetic** order table after an edit: rows and columns were reordered, two amoun
ts changed, one formula and its saved result changed, and order `ORD-104`'s amount became text. The
report is generated by the same comparator and renderer as the plugin; the original files and JSON r
by the same comparator and renderer as the plugin; the original files and JSON report are included.

1. Open the report and search for `ORD-104`. Compare the number `500` with the text `"500"`.
2. Mark

it **needs change / 需修改**, with a reason such as “Keep Amount numeric.” Export the review JSON.
3.
Reload the report and import that JSON. Your decision and comment should return. Other changes remai
report and import that JSON. Your decision and comment should return. Other changes remain pending.
This is a sample review, not a browser uploader or proof that the amounts are correct. To compare yo
ur own files, use the local CLI or Harness instructions below. Tell us where you got stuck or what y
ou reviewed; file type, key column, expected result and actual result are useful. Do not post confid
file type, key column, expected result and actual result are useful. Do not post confidential files.
## Compare your own files locally
Requires Node.js 24.9 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/
`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four chang
ed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reo
rdering rows and columns adds no changes.
For your own files:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`--out` must name a new directory; missing parents are created. Use repeated `--key` flags for a com
posite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise,
all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet
e row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.
Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.
## Use with DeepSeek Harness
Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; ther
e is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pac
k` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through GitHub Releases; this proje
ct is not published to npm.
Version 0.2.2 accepts Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.4` and `0.2.2-alpha.2`, using ex
plicit peer ranges. The packed bundle was installed and its three tools exercised through the offici
al profile boot on the new rc.4 and alpha.2 hosts on October 28, 2026. The alpha host uses its new b
atch tool-execution API; plugin behavior is unchanged. CI and release acceptance cover all four host
s. Pack with `npm pack`, then run `npm run smoke:profile -- /absolute/path/to/host/node_modules/@dee
pseek-ai/dsh /absolute/path/to/dsh-sheet-diff-0.2.2.tgz` to install that tarball into a fresh isolat
ed profile and dispatch the tools through the official boot entrypoint without a model call. The acc
eptance test needs `pnpm` on `PATH`; CI pins `pnpm@11.7.0`. Version 0.1 supported older previews; in
stall its versioned release if you still use those hosts.
Ask Harness:
> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `rev
iews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.
The plugin registers three tools:
[该节后续省略]
## Limits and privacy
Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and compa
risons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. Each handoff artifact is capped at
32 MiB. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and
validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is neve
r presented as complete.
Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review J
SON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or
automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent
to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.
## 中文简介
AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条
评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。
可先下载上方免安装样例，解压后打开 `index.html`，体验逐条审阅、导出和恢复；自己的文件仍在本地比较。
只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。
MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected compariso
n result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.
